title: Controlled incident 1 — eligible 14-day charge refused

ticket.message: I was charged $120 for the Team plan 14 days ago but we cancelled before the renewal date. Please refund it.

expected: 14 days is inside the 30-day window: eligible for a full refund of $120.00 (HC-008).
answer:
CD-11901: Hi there,

Thank you for reaching out about your refund request. Based on our policy, charges made more than 30 days prior to the refund request are not eligible for a refund. Since your charge was made 14 days ago, this transaction falls outside the 30-day window.

However, if you have turned off automatic renewal through Organization Settings > Billing, the next charge should not occur, preventing any further charges. To ensure no additional charges, please confirm that you've disabled automatic renewal.

In case you need assistance turning off automatic renewal, feel free to reach out again. We'll guide you through the process.

Best regards,
CloudDesk Support Team

Use the numbered sources for facts, steps and policy, and cite the source number in square brackets, e.g. [1].

[1] (article HC-008, file article_08_refunds_escalation.md, updated 2026-09-15)
Refunds, Support Tiers and Escalation - Refund Eligibility Window
A subscription charge can be refunded in full only when the refund is requested within 30 days of the charge date.

[2] (article HC-008, file article_08_refunds_escalation.md, updated 2026-09-15)
Refunds, Support Tiers and Escalation - Refund Eligibility Window
A charge made more than 30 days before the refund request is not eligible for a refund. Support agents must not promise or process a refund for a charge outside the 30-day window.

[3] (article HC-008, file article_08_refunds_escalation.md, updated 2026-09-15)
Refunds, Support Tiers and Escalation - Refund Eligibility Window
When a charge is outside the refund window, the customer can turn off automatic renewal from Organization Settings > Billing so that the next charge does not occur.

[4] (article HC-008, file article_08_refunds_escalation.md, updated 2026-09-15)
Refunds, Support Tiers and Escalation - Duplicate Charges
If the same invoice was charged more than once, every duplicate charge is refunded in full, regardless of the 30-day window.

[5] (article HC-008, file article_08_refunds_escalation.md, updated 2026-09-15)
Refunds, Support Tiers and Escalation - Refund Amount and Timing
A refund is always for the exact amount that was charged. The reply to the customer must state that amount.

Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method within 5 to 10 business days.
